About this page

Data pulled 2026-09-15T09:00:00-07:00 from acme.gainsightcloud.com. Window 2026-06 to 2026-09; sends on or after 2026-09-01 are provisional (opens keep arriving), and bounces and unsubscribes on sends since 2026-08-01 can still change (the 2 months a refresh reads again).

Definitions

Every figure can be checked on its own: build a report in Gainsight on the object named, with the filters and the date field named, and count the rows.

Internal recipients are addresses ending in @acme.com. External figures are all recipients minus internal ones; distinct counts are asked for external recipients on their own.

Sent
Every email attempt in the period, whether or not it went out. Every recipient and every repeat send counts.
  • Read from: email_log_v2
  • Counts: every row (no field condition)
  • Filters on every count: Source = "Advanced Outreach"; AddressType = "To"
  • Date field: ExecutedDate
  • Calculation: COUNT of rows
  • Per-step rows are read from: ao_emails: every row (no field condition); filter AddressType = "To"; date field CreatedAt
  • Against the Gainsight UI: The program analytics page in Gainsight labels the went-out count "Sent". This figure is every attempt, so it is the higher of the two whenever an attempt bounced at send or was rejected.
Delivered
Attempts that went out and did not bounce. An attempt that went out and bounced afterwards counts as bounced, not delivered.
  • Read from: email_log_v2
  • Counts: IsSent = YES and IsBounced is not YES
  • Filters on every count: Source = "Advanced Outreach"; AddressType = "To"
  • Date field: ExecutedDate
  • Calculation: COUNT of rows
  • Per-step rows are read from: ao_emails: EmailSend = true and Bounce is not true; filter AddressType = "To"; date field CreatedAt
  • Against the Gainsight UI: The program analytics page in Gainsight subtracts every bounce event from its own "Sent" for "Delivered", including bounces on attempts that never went out, so it reads lower than this figure.
Bounced
Attempts flagged as bounced, counted as events, whether or not the attempt went out.
  • Read from: email_log_v2
  • Counts: IsBounced = YES
  • Filters on every count: Source = "Advanced Outreach"; AddressType = "To"
  • Date field: ExecutedDate
  • Calculation: COUNT of rows
  • Per-step rows are read from: ao_emails: Bounce = true; filter AddressType = "To"; date field CreatedAt
  • Against the Gainsight UI: Matches the bounce count in Gainsight. The classic Journey Analytics view shows a lower bounce percentage, on a basis that could not be determined.
Rejected
Attempts the mail service rejected.
  • Read from: email_log_v2
  • Counts: IsRejected = YES
  • Filters on every count: Source = "Advanced Outreach"; AddressType = "To"
  • Date field: ExecutedDate
  • Calculation: COUNT of rows
  • Per-step rows are read from: ao_emails: Rejected = true; filter AddressType = "To"; date field CreatedAt
Unsubscribed
Attempts whose recipient unsubscribed from that email.
  • Read from: email_log_v2
  • Counts: IsUnsubscribed = YES
  • Filters on every count: Source = "Advanced Outreach"; AddressType = "To"
  • Date field: ExecutedDate
  • Calculation: COUNT of rows
  • Per-step rows are read from: ao_emails: Unsubscribed = true; filter AddressType = "To"; date field CreatedAt
Spam complaints
Attempts whose recipient marked the email as spam.
  • Read from: email_log_v2
  • Counts: IsSpam = YES
  • Filters on every count: Source = "Advanced Outreach"; AddressType = "To"
  • Date field: ExecutedDate
  • Calculation: COUNT of rows
  • Per-step rows are read from: ao_emails: Spam = true; filter AddressType = "To"; date field CreatedAt
Send failures
Attempts that bounced or were rejected, each counted once even when both flags are set.
  • Read from: email_log_v2
  • Counts: IsBounced = YES or IsRejected = YES
  • Filters on every count: Source = "Advanced Outreach"; AddressType = "To"
  • Date field: ExecutedDate
  • Calculation: COUNT of rows
  • Per-step rows are read from: ao_emails: Bounce = true or Rejected = true; filter AddressType = "To"; date field CreatedAt
Opened
Attempts flagged as opened. An open is an image-pixel load.
  • Read from: email_log_v2
  • Counts: IsOpened = YES
  • Filters on every count: Source = "Advanced Outreach"; AddressType = "To"
  • Date field: ExecutedDate
  • Calculation: COUNT of rows
  • Per-step rows are read from: ao_emails: EmailOpened = true; filter AddressType = "To"; date field CreatedAt
  • Against the Gainsight UI: Matches the opened count in Gainsight.
Clicked
Attempts with at least one click on a content link. Unsubscribe and mailto links do not count.
  • Read from: email_log_v2
  • Counts: LinkClickedCount > 0, then each link in LinkClickedJson
  • Filters on every count: Source = "Advanced Outreach"; AddressType = "To"
  • Date field: ExecutedDate
  • Calculation: COUNT of rows
  • After the read: Each clicked link is classified after the read. A link is not content when it matches /^mailto:/ (mailto) or /unsubscribe|opt[-_]?out|email[-_]?preferences|manage[-_]?preferences/ (unsubscribe); every other link is content.
  • After the read: This pull also treated links on www.acme.com/mail-settings as unsubscribe links (the --unsubscribe-link input).
  • Per-step rows are read from: ao_emails: EmailClicked = true, kept only where the same send has a content-link click in email_log_v2; filter AddressType = "To"; date field CreatedAt
  • Against the Gainsight UI: Will rarely match Gainsight, whose clicked figure also counts unsubscribe and mailto clicks.
Open rate
The share of delivered attempts that were opened.
  • Read from: email_log_v2
  • Counts: Opened: IsOpened = YES. Delivered: IsSent = YES and IsBounced is not YES.
  • Filters on every count: Source = "Advanced Outreach"; AddressType = "To"
  • Date field: ExecutedDate
  • Calculation: Opened ÷ Delivered Blank, never 0%, when Delivered is 0.
  • Against the Gainsight UI: Follows the formula of the Dynamic Program analytics view, on this report's Delivered.
Click rate
The share of delivered attempts with a content-link click.
  • Read from: email_log_v2
  • Counts: Clicked: LinkClickedCount > 0, then each link in LinkClickedJson. Delivered: IsSent = YES and IsBounced is not YES.
  • Filters on every count: Source = "Advanced Outreach"; AddressType = "To"
  • Date field: ExecutedDate
  • Calculation: Clicked ÷ Delivered Blank, never 0%, when Delivered is 0.
  • Against the Gainsight UI: Will rarely match Gainsight: content links only.
Bounce rate
Bounce events as a share of attempts.
  • Read from: email_log_v2
  • Counts: Bounced: IsBounced = YES. Sent: every row (no field condition).
  • Filters on every count: Source = "Advanced Outreach"; AddressType = "To"
  • Date field: ExecutedDate
  • Calculation: Bounced ÷ Sent Blank, never 0%, when Sent is 0.
  • Against the Gainsight UI: The classic Journey Analytics view shows a lower bounce percentage, on a basis that could not be determined.
Rejected rate
Rejected attempts as a share of attempts.
  • Read from: email_log_v2
  • Counts: Rejected: IsRejected = YES. Sent: every row (no field condition).
  • Filters on every count: Source = "Advanced Outreach"; AddressType = "To"
  • Date field: ExecutedDate
  • Calculation: Rejected ÷ Sent Blank, never 0%, when Sent is 0.
Unsubscribe rate
Unsubscribes as a share of attempts.
  • Read from: email_log_v2
  • Counts: Unsubscribed: IsUnsubscribed = YES. Sent: every row (no field condition).
  • Filters on every count: Source = "Advanced Outreach"; AddressType = "To"
  • Date field: ExecutedDate
  • Calculation: Unsubscribed ÷ Sent Blank, never 0%, when Sent is 0.
Spam complaint rate
Spam complaints as a share of attempts.
  • Read from: email_log_v2
  • Counts: Spam complaints: IsSpam = YES. Sent: every row (no field condition).
  • Filters on every count: Source = "Advanced Outreach"; AddressType = "To"
  • Date field: ExecutedDate
  • Calculation: Spam complaints ÷ Sent Blank, never 0%, when Sent is 0.
Error rate
Attempts that bounced or were rejected, as a share of attempts.
  • Read from: email_log_v2
  • Counts: Send failures: IsBounced = YES or IsRejected = YES. Sent: every row (no field condition).
  • Filters on every count: Source = "Advanced Outreach"; AddressType = "To"
  • Date field: ExecutedDate
  • Calculation: Send failures ÷ Sent Blank, never 0%, when Sent is 0.
Unique recipients
Distinct people the program emailed, exact per program.
  • Read from: email_log_v2
  • Counts: distinct person.Gsid, through GsPersonId
  • Filters on every count: Source = "Advanced Outreach"; AddressType = "To"
  • Date field: ExecutedDate
  • Calculation: COUNT DISTINCT, per program
  • After the read: A distinct count is asked for per program, for the whole window and for each month. It is never added across programs or months.
  • Against the Gainsight UI: Close to the Contacts figure in Gainsight.
Accounts reached
Distinct companies the program emailed, exact per program. Sends with no company link reach no account.
  • Read from: email_log_v2
  • Counts: distinct company.Gsid, through GsCompanyId
  • Filters on every count: Source = "Advanced Outreach"; AddressType = "To"
  • Date field: ExecutedDate
  • Calculation: COUNT DISTINCT, per program
  • After the read: A distinct count is asked for per program, for the whole window and for each month. It is never added across programs or months.
Submitted
Survey participants of the program whose response is Submitted.
  • Read from: survey_participant
  • Counts: Responded = true and ResponseStatus = "Submitted"
  • Filters on every count: TestParticipant = false
  • Date field: None for the all-time figures (no date filter). Monthly counts are bucketed by RespondedDate.
  • Calculation: COUNT of rows
  • After the read: Attributed to the program through ao_participants.AdvancedOutreachId, through AOParticipantId.
  • Against the Gainsight UI: Matches the program's analytics page in Gainsight.
Partially submitted
Survey participants of the program whose response is Partially Submitted.
  • Read from: survey_participant
  • Counts: Responded = true and ResponseStatus = "Partially Submitted"
  • Filters on every count: TestParticipant = false
  • Date field: None for the all-time figures (no date filter). Monthly counts are bucketed by RespondedDate.
  • Calculation: COUNT of rows
  • After the read: Attributed to the program through ao_participants.AdvancedOutreachId, through AOParticipantId.
  • Against the Gainsight UI: Matches the program's analytics page in Gainsight.
Any response
Submitted plus Partially submitted.
  • Read from: survey_participant
  • Counts: Responded = true and ResponseStatus = "Submitted", plus Responded = true and ResponseStatus = "Partially Submitted"
  • Filters on every count: TestParticipant = false
  • Date field: None for the all-time figures (no date filter). Monthly counts are bucketed by RespondedDate.
  • Calculation: Submitted + Partially submitted
  • After the read: Attributed to the program through ao_participants.AdvancedOutreachId, through AOParticipantId.
Survey participants
Every survey participant of the program, all time. It is the response rate's denominator.
  • Read from: survey_participant
  • Counts: every row of the program (no field condition)
  • Filters on every count: TestParticipant = false
  • Date field: None for the all-time figures (no date filter). Monthly counts are bucketed by RespondedDate.
  • Calculation: COUNT of rows
  • After the read: Attributed to the program through ao_participants.AdvancedOutreachId, through AOParticipantId.
  • Against the Gainsight UI: Matches the program's analytics page in Gainsight.
Response rate
The share of the program's survey participants with any response, all time.
  • Read from: survey_participant
  • Counts: Any response: Responded = true and ResponseStatus = "Submitted", plus Responded = true and ResponseStatus = "Partially Submitted". Survey participants: every row of the program (no field condition).
  • Filters on every count: TestParticipant = false
  • Date field: None for the all-time figures (no date filter). Monthly counts are bucketed by RespondedDate.
  • Calculation: Any response ÷ Survey participants Blank, never 0%, when Survey participants is 0.

How to use this page

  • Filters at the top narrow every panel at once: the months, a searchable program list (select all or none), the dashboard's groups, status, whether internal recipients count. The address bar keeps the filters you set, so a view can be bookmarked or shared; Reset filters clears them.
  • Tabs: Engagement, Health, Templates, About.
  • Every table has Columns to show or hide any figure (remembered in this browser) and Download CSV, which exports the table's current view. A chart has the same rows as a table underneath.
  • A plain 0% is a real 0%. "Not tracked" means no link in the email is click-tracked, so there is no number. A figure marked "(tracking unknown)" is shown, but the data cannot tell whether clicks are tracked.
  • * marks a figure that includes the provisional period; † marks one that includes months carried forward from an earlier pull.
  • On the Health tab the no-send threshold has buttons (14, 30, 45, 60, 90 days); expected failures sit behind a toggle.
  • The Templates tab lists each email with its performance and the programs that send it; the column headings sort it. Search finds the emails whose subject or body holds your words (any of them, or all of them, as whole words or not) and shows where; Text opens an email's current text, which is the text as the knowledge base holds it, not necessarily what was sent, and the table says whether it was edited after its last send.
  • An account's history over days needs a pull of its own: the account timeline command, which needs a gs-admin login. Anyone else sees a company only through this page's account lists.

This dashboard's settings

Dashboard
"program-health", a dashboard spec of version 1.
Title
Acme program health
Owner
Acme CS Ops
Purpose
Which programs need attention this month.
Tenant
Refreshed from acme.gainsightcloud.com, and from no other tenant.
Data source
Journey Orchestrator email engagement, read from the tenant's send log.
Programs
Only programs that have sent since 90 days before each refresh. A program's status never limits what is pulled; the status filter decides what shows.
Window
The last 13 months, the current one included. The current month is provisional: opens keep arriving.
Internal recipients
Addresses at acme.com are internal.
Unsubscribe link
Clicks on https://www.acme.com/mail-settings are unsubscribe clicks, not content clicks.
Named accounts
0 test accounts and 1 pinned account. Named accounts are always kept as their own rows when accounts are pulled.
Step detail
Off: emails are reported per template, with the step's name where a template sits on one step. Turning it on adds step, variant and participant-record figures and makes each refresh longer.
Months read again
A refresh reads the last 2 months again and keeps earlier months as they were last read.
Filters
Date range: the months shown.
Programs: a searchable list of every program in the dashboard.
Group: the dashboard's own supergroups and groups.
Status: Active, Paused, Draft or Stopped, as of the last refresh.
Recipients: everyone, or external recipients only (the company's own domains and test accounts left out); starts on everyone.
Accounts
Customer lists are on: per program, the 20 busiest accounts, the 15 lowest open rates among accounts with at least 10 delivered, and the 15 with the most bounces. Every other account is in one "all other accounts" row, so totals stay exact.
Groups
1. Supergroup "Surveys": programs that send a survey.
2. Supergroup "Internal": programs sent to internal users.
3. Supergroup "Recurring": programs on a recurring schedule.
4. Supergroup: programs by folder: Renewals (folder id 202). Folder names are not available from Gainsight, so each label is the one given here.
5. Group "CSAT" (inside Surveys): programs whose model is CSAT_SURVEY_V2.
6. Group: programs by name: part 2 of the name, split on " ", is the group.
1 program placed by hand, ahead of any rule.
Rules apply in the order listed, supergroups first. A program no rule reaches is in "Ungrouped".
Silent programs
An Active program with no send in 45 days is listed as silent.
Pages
"Admin" (admin): for the people who run the programs: every tab, per-program and per-email detail, account names. Tabs: engagement, health, templates, about. Shows programs of every status at first; the others are one click away. Starts on the whole window, with the current month marked provisional. No panel of its own: the admin preset's 17 panels. Account names may show; definitions show the object, fields and filters behind each number; template text (subjects, bodies, the keyword search) is on the page.
"This period" on the engagement tab: headline figures, each beside the usual and the change against it of Sent, Delivered, Opened, Open rate, Click rate.
"Open rate by month" on the engagement tab: a monthly trend of Open rate, Click rate by month.
"Sends by month" on the engagement tab: a bar chart of Sent, Delivered, Opened by month.
"Programs" on the engagement tab: a table of Sent, Unique recipients, Accounts reached, Delivered, Opened, Open rate, Clicked, Click rate, Bounced, Send failures, Error rate by program.
"Emails" on the engagement tab: a table of Sent, Delivered, Opened, Open rate, Click rate by program and template.
"Steps" on the engagement tab: a table of Sent, Delivered, Opened, Open rate, Click rate by program and step and variant.
"Survey responses" on the engagement tab: a table of Survey participants, Submitted, Partially submitted, Any response, Response rate by program.
"Most engaged customers (possible advocates)" on the engagement tab: a ranked short list of accounts across programs, with each account's programs underneath of Delivered, Opened, Open rate, Bounced by account, the top 25 by Open rate.
"Least engaged customers (possible bad contacts or disengagement)" on the engagement tab: a ranked short list of accounts across programs, with each account's programs underneath of Delivered, Opened, Open rate, Bounced by account, the top 25 by Open rate.
"Most bounced customers (possible bad contacts)" on the engagement tab: a ranked short list of accounts across programs, with each account's programs underneath of Delivered, Opened, Open rate, Bounced by account, the top 25 by Bounced.
"Send health" on the health tab: headline figures, each beside the usual and the change against it of Error rate, Bounce rate, Rejected rate, Unsubscribe rate, Spam complaint rate.
"Program health" on the health tab: program health: every Active program's signals and the one list it lands on, with the no-send threshold adjustable in the page; the no-send threshold starts at 45 days (14, 30, 60 and 90 are one click away).
"Why sends and participants fail" on the health tab: why sends and participants fail, by category, each against its usual, with expected failures (business rules working) behind a toggle; expected failures are behind a toggle.
"Schedules" on the health tab: each program's schedule as the knowledge base documents it, with the day it is as of and a stale mark; a schedule documented more than 45 days before the pull is marked stale.
"One-time and ad-hoc programs" on the health tab: one-time and ad-hoc programs with their send history; each program's sends over the last 6 months.
"Error rate by program" on the health tab: a table of Sent, Send failures, Error rate, Bounced, Bounce rate, Rejected, Rejected rate, Unsubscribed, Unsubscribe rate, Spam complaints, Spam complaint rate by program.
"Emails: text and search" on the templates tab: each email's performance per program and step, its current text, and keyword search over subjects and bodies; a search hit shows 50 characters of context either side.
"Leadership" (exec): for leaders who read the numbers: Engagement and About, every status, no account names. Tabs: engagement, about. Shows programs of every status at first; the others are one click away. Starts on the closed months, with the current month one click away. No panel of its own: the exec preset's 6 panels. Account names never show; definitions do not show the object, fields and filters behind each number; template text (subjects, bodies, the keyword search) is not on the page.
"Headline" on the engagement tab: headline figures, each beside the usual and the change against it of Sent, Delivered, Open rate, Click rate.
"Open rate by month" on the engagement tab: a monthly trend of Open rate, Click rate by month.
"Sends by month" on the engagement tab: a bar chart of Sent, Delivered, Opened by month.
"By group" on the engagement tab: a table of Sent, Delivered, Open rate by supergroup and group.
"Top programs by open rate" on the engagement tab: a table of Sent, Open rate by program, the top 10 by Open rate.
"Lowest open rates" on the engagement tab: a table of Sent, Open rate by program, the top 10 by Open rate.
Freshness
A page shows a stale banner once its data is more than 45 days old.
Refresh
Refreshed every month; a refresh can also be run at any time. Run on the first Monday.
Publishing
Not published anywhere: the pages are files in the workspace.
Gainsight reports

Caveats

  • 1 program(s) have no full doc in the knowledge base, so their emails are listed by template name, without step names.
  • Step names come from the knowledge base, as of the date each program was last documented (the oldest is 2026-08-20T00:00:00.000Z). A step renamed since then shows its earlier name.
  • Schedule configuration (the cron, its start and end dates) comes from the knowledge base, as of the date each program was last documented (the oldest is 2026-08-20T00:00:00.000Z); the knowledge base is refreshed when a program's configuration changes. Whether a schedule is still running is read from each participant source's last sync time at this pull, never from the schedule's own run-state fields: on the measured tenant those are unset even on programs that run daily. A documented schedule that ended before its source last synced is read as documentation behind the tenant (Cannot judge yet), never as an ended schedule.
  • The knowledge base is behind the tenant for 1 selected program(s): 1 has no doc (created after the KB's last journey capture) and 0 were modified after their doc was written. An undocumented program's schedule is unknown to this pull, so it reads Cannot judge yet (no doc) and is never read as a one-off; a program with a doc behind the tenant is judged from that doc and flagged. Run /gs-superadmin:refresh for these programs only (the plan wrote their keys to kb-gap-keys.json; about 3 seconds) and pull again.
  • Template subjects and bodies are each template's CURRENT text as the knowledge base holds it (the oldest doc is as of 2026-08-20), not a copy of what was sent: a template edited after its last send may differ from what recipients got, and the "edited after last send" flag says which. Tokens are shown as their field labels.
  • 1 of 6 template(s) the sends reference have no doc in the knowledge base, so their text and link settings are not in this snapshot. The plan lists them; the skill's gap-fill fetches each one by id and files it in the knowledge base.
  • 1 template doc(s) were read before the month of the template's last send, so the text may predate what was sent. The next gap-fill reads them again.
  • 1 never-clicked template(s) have no link-tracking reading in the knowledge base (their docs predate it), so their click tracking reads unknown. The next gap-fill reads them again.
  • 3 entry-refusal wording(s) in the samples of 2 program(s) match no known category and are labelled "unclassified" (kind unknown): 4 sampled participant(s), 8 refusal(s) in all. An unknown product wording is treated as a failure needing investigation, never as a business rule or a known error. Read the texts in the snapshot's failureSamples table (terminal only; they never reach a page) and report them with /gs-superadmin:report-bug so the shipped list can learn them, or add them to this tenant's --failure-categories file. 1 bounce wording(s) in the samples of 3 program(s) match no category of this dashboard's list and are counted as "other" (mail-server text, which no shipped list carries): the only remedy is this tenant's --failure-categories file, read from the snapshot's failureSamples table (terminal only).
  • participantFailures, participantStates are all time: the objects they are read from carry no date on every row, so the date filter does not apply to them.
  • Participant failures are counted per program with no breakdown by reason. This tenant's object does not allow a filter on the reason field, so participant failures are counted per program with no breakdown by reason.
  • The breakdown of refused participants by reason is a SAMPLE: one page per program of the refusals still happening in the day window, the most repeated first, because the reason field takes no filter on this tenant. The totals beside it are exact. Each sampled text carries how many participants it refused and how many times in all.
  • Sends on or after 2026-09-01 are provisional: opens keep arriving, so the recent period reads low. Bounces and unsubscribes on sends since 2026-08-01 can still change too: a refresh reads those months again.
  • Send failures and the error rate count attempts that bounced or were rejected. A participant a program could not process never becomes an attempt, so it is not in the rate; those are counted separately, with their reasons.
  • Opens are image-pixel loads. Apple Mail Privacy Protection and security scanners inflate them, and blocked images hide real ones. Compare programs with each other, not with an outside benchmark.
  • Click figures count content links only. Unsubscribe and mailto clicks are left out, so they will rarely match the Gainsight UI.
  • Click tracking may not be enabled. "Not tracked" means no link in the email is click-tracked, so there is no figure. "(tracking unknown)" means the data cannot tell whether clicks are tracked: the figure is shown, and a 0 there may not be a real 0. A program reads tracked only when every one of its templates is.
  • Open rate and click rate divide by Delivered (went out and did not bounce). A send that was opened and bounced afterwards counts as opened and not delivered, which can lift the rate of a very small group.
  • Unique recipients, accounts reached and participant records are exact per program, for the whole window and for each single month. They are never added across programs or months, and show — for any other date range.
  • Survey responses are counted per program, with test participants left out. They match the program's analytics page in Gainsight. The survey's own analytics page counts every program that ever sent the survey, deleted ones included, and includes test responses, so it reads higher.
  • Survey response figures and the response rate are all time, not limited to the report's window: the denominator has no date.
  • Program status is today's status. There is no status history.
  • 4 CC copies are left out: only "To" recipients are counted.
  • 4 email(s) sent by other Gainsight features are left out: only Journey Orchestrator sends are counted.
  • 12 send(s) name no template. They are counted in their program, on a row with no template.
  • 3 test participant(s) are left out of the survey figures.
